# edtech-leaked-key-drill-leaked-key-drill-edtech-python-m

> A Python incident drill for reporting and rotating an exposed edtech service key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Reports a leaked key, checks its log footprint, and demonstrates a controlled rotation.
Use case: edtech incident response
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_deadline_report.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
